rics.description: BIS, Nominal Broad Effective Exchange Rate Index
rics.meaning: BIS Nominal Broad Effective Exchange Rate Index for IDR — trade-weighted IDR vs basket of trading partners' currencies, in nominal terms. Compiled by the Bank for International Settlements; rebased to 100.
rics.how_to_use: Better than IDR/USD alone for tracking IDR competitiveness — captures moves vs CNY, JPY, EUR, AUD, MYR, SGD (Indonesia's main trade partners). Falling NEER = IDR weakening on a trade-weighted basis. Use alongside the real EER (aIDBISRXBR) for inflation-adjusted competitiveness.

rics.description: BIS, Real Broad Effective Exchange Rate Index
rics.meaning: BIS Real Broad Effective Exchange Rate Index for IDR — trade-weighted IDR adjusted for relative inflation against trading partners. The 'true' competitiveness gauge.
rics.how_to_use: Most analytically meaningful FX gauge. Rising real EER = IDR getting more expensive in real terms = exports become less competitive. Indonesia's real EER stayed elevated 2010-2014 (commodity supercycle) then weakened post-2015 — supporting the trade balance recovery. Watch for sustained real EER appreciation as a current-account deterioration signal.

rics.description: Purchasing power parity, National currency per USD
rics.meaning: Purchasing Power Parity, National currency per USD — same conceptual measure as aIDOAPPPGR.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check series. Use either for cross-country price-level comparisons.

rics.meaning: Indonesian Rupiah per US Dollar — the headline IDR/USD spot rate. Daily fixing published by Bank Indonesia (Jakarta Interbank Spot Dollar Rate, JISDOR) around 10:00 WIB.
rics.how_to_use: THE Indonesia FX rate. Recent range: 14,500-16,800. Sustained moves above 16,500 typically trigger BI verbal then physical intervention (FX sales from reserves). DXY (broad USD index) and EM risk sentiment dominate near-term moves; commodity prices (coal, palm oil) and current account balance drive the trend. Pair with aIDCRESA (FX reserves) — sustained reserve drawdowns alongside IDR weakness signal stressed defense.
